name: Application Shell
description: Stable application frame that composes the governed Top Navbar, Sidebar, optional Page Heading, and consumer-owned page content. Application Shell owns responsive placement, shell landmarks, and the 1200px expanded/compact decision only; product workflows retain their own query, selection, draft, request, record, permission, and backend state.

stateModel.description: Responsive decision source: auto follows the governed 1200 CSS-pixel threshold; expanded and compact are deterministic evidence/test overrides.
Effective expanded or compact shell mode used to supply the governed Sidebar mode and shell layout.
All page/workflow state inside the shell, including query, selection, draft, request, outcome, and product data, remains owned by the consumer and must survive shell mode changes.

transitions.event: viewport reaches at least 1200 CSS px

transitions.to: matching explicit expanded or compact mode

invariants: Changing resolved layout mode must not remount the consumer page content or reset workflow state.
Sidebar remains the governed Sidebar component; Application Shell supplies only its resolved mode and physical shell placement.
Top Navbar remains the governed Top Navbar component and stays before navigation/page content in landmark order.
Optional Page Heading remains consumer-supplied governed page context before page children; Application Shell does not recreate heading internals.
Shell placement uses logical inline flow so Sidebar and main content support RTL without a separate direction prop.
The main region scrolls when the viewport is short or content is long; shell layout must not clip away reachable page actions.
Theme and language are inherited contexts and do not become Application Shell props.
responsiveRules: At 1200 CSS px and above, auto mode resolves to expanded navigation.
Below 1200 CSS px, auto mode resolves to compact navigation.
Expanded Sidebar width is 208 CSS px and compact Sidebar width is 64 CSS px, using the approved Sidebar/layout contract rather than a duplicate shell primitive.
Page content uses a 32 CSS px logical inset, yielding the reviewed 1168px content width at 1440 and 832px content width at 960.
Supported desktop evidence spans 960–1440 CSS px with explicit compact 1199px and expanded 1200px boundary proofs.
At 320 CSS px and browser zoom conditions, the shell must still reflow without losing navigation or page access; horizontally large child content may overflow inside the scrollable main region.
runtimeRequirements: Render stable native shell landmarks in reading order: the supplied Top Navbar header, Sidebar nav, then one main region containing optional Page Heading and page content.
Verify the 1199/1200 CSS-pixel auto-mode boundary in browser-oriented evidence.
Verify resizing across the breakpoint changes shell/Sidebar presentation without resetting or remounting consumer state.
Verify a short window scrolls the main region so page actions remain reachable by pointer and keyboard.
Auto mode must not read browser globals unsafely during server rendering.
Expanded and compact evidence must preserve the same consumer children and navigation identity.

Sidebar, Top Navbar, and optional Page Heading shell-slot props must receive the direct governed React elements; wrapper components are not accepted because Application Shell validates element identity and clones the Sidebar element to inject resolved mode.
forbidden: wrapper components around governed shell-slot elements

props.name: sidebar
props.description: Required direct governed Sidebar React element. Pass <Sidebar ... /> itself, not a wrapper component that returns Sidebar, because Application Shell validates the element type and clones the direct element to supply the resolved expanded or compact mode.

props.name: topNavbar
props.description: Required direct governed Top Navbar React element rendered before navigation and main content. Pass <TopNavbar ... /> itself, not a wrapper component that returns TopNavbar, because Application Shell validates the direct element type.

props.name: pageHeading
props.description: Optional direct governed Page Heading React element rendered before page content inside the main region. Pass <PageHeading ... /> itself, not a wrapper component that returns PageHeading, because Application Shell validates the direct element type.

props.name: children
props.description: Required consumer-owned page content rendered inside the stable main content region without being remounted across shell mode changes.

props.name: viewportMode
props.description: Optional shell layout decision source. auto follows the governed 1200 CSS-pixel breakpoint; expanded and compact are deterministic overrides.
